senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (लजति) also (इ) लजि (लञ्जति)
1 To fry.
2 To affront, to insult.
(ओ ई) ओलजी r. 6th cl. (लजति-ते)
To be ashamed, to be modest or bashful.
r. 10th cl. (लाजयति)
To hide, to cover, to screen or clothe:
also (लजति) or (इ) लजि (लञ्जयति)
1 To be manifest or apparent.
2 To shine.
(इ) लजि (लञ्जयति)
1 To give.
2 To dwell.
3 To injure.
4 To be strong.
5 To censure.

f. (-ज्जा)
Shame, modesty, bashfulness.
E.
लस्ज to be modest, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

r. 1st cl. (लाजति) (इ) लाजि (लांजति)
1 To blame or censure.
2 To fry.

m. (-जः)
Grain, wetted or sprinkled.
n. (-जं)
The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
f. (-जा) or masc. plu. (-जाः)
Fried grain.
E.
लाज to fry, aff. घञ्.

f. (-का)
The sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.)
E.
लज for लज्जा shame, कारिका making, shewing.

mfn. (-ज्जन्-ज्जन्ती-ज्जत्)
Being ashamed, blushing, shrinking.
E.
लस्ज to be ashamed, and शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being ashamed.
E.
लस्ज to be ashamed, aff. शानच्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रा-रं)
Shameful, causing shame.
E.
लज्जा, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-रि-रिणी-रि)
Causing or occasioning shame.
E.
लज्जा, and कारिन् what makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ashamed, bashful.
E.
लज्जा, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shameless, immodest.
E.
लज्जा, and रहित void of.

m. (-लुः)
A sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.)
E.
लज्जा shame, हालुक् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Modest, bashful.
E.
लज्जा, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Bashful, modest.
E.
लज्जा modest, शील possessing.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Shameless, impudent.
E.
लज्जा, and हीन void of.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ashamed, modest.
E.
लज्जा Modesty, इतच् aff.

f. (-ज्ज्या)
Modesty, bashfulness.
E.
लस्ज to be ashamed, य aff.
